## What's Changed The app automatically checks for and installs updated versions of itself every time it starts. The screensaver can't update itself, but it shows a warning. Just run the app to update the screensaver. * auto update with sparkle including visible indicator [#320](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/320) * report GPU and CPU usage in F2 overlay [#163](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/163) * add disk full warning [#366](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/366) * increase performance of the OSD [#417](https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/issues/417)
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/e-dream-ai/client/compare/0.12.0...0.14.0
